summary: The attached joint report (March 27, 2018) from the City Manager and the Deputy City Manager, Cluster B, proposes that City Council appoint a new Chief Building Official and Executive Director. Subsection 3(2) of the Building Code Act, 1992 requires that the council of each municipality appoint a Chief Building Official and Executive Director. Additionally, Chapter 169-6 of the Municipal Code provides that the Chief Building Official and Executive Director shall be appointed by City Council on the recommendation of the City Manager. The matter is urgent as an interim Chief Building Official and Executive Director was appointed in the Fall of 2017. A recruitment process was undertaken and City Council should appoint a permanent Chief Building Official and Executive Director as soon as possible.
decided: City Council on March 26 and 27, 2018, adopted the following: 1. City Council appoint William Johnston to the position of Chief Building Official and Executive Director for the City of Toronto, with such appointment to be effective April 9, 2018, subject to and following written acceptance by Mr. Johnston of the terms and conditions of a contract of employment offered by the City, on or before April 8, 2018. 2. City Council authorize the Deputy City Manager, Cluster B to negotiate terms and conditions of employment with Mr. Johnston. 3. City Council repeal By-law 1265-2017, being the by-law that appointed Diane Elizabeth Damiano as Chief Building Official and Executive Director for the City of Toronto on an interim basis effective on the date upon which the appointment of William Johnston takes effect. 4. City Council authorize the appropriate City officials to take the necessary action to give effect to City Council's decision, including the introduction in City Council of the necessary bill to appoint William Johnston as Chief Building Official and Executive Director under the Building Code Act, 1992, and to rescind the appointment of Diane Elizabeth Damiano as Chief Building Official and Executive Director for the City of Toronto on an interim basis. 5.
